title: Base Layer
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Every painting starts with a base layer, a rough foundation to build on.
It’s not pretty, it’s not polished, it’s not the masterpiece.
It’s just… the starting point.

You have a base layer too: your past, your habits, your scars.
But that’s not your final picture.
Every day you add little strokes.
Some strokes are messy, some are bold, some are soft.

You can paint over the rough spots.
You can brighten the canvas.
You can start fresh, right on top of what came before.

Your life is a work in progress — not a finished painting.
